text:
Relayed all four simplification-desk specs to their lanes: L-S1 chat-023865708e, L-S2 chat-9253405cdb, L-S3 chat-4443adab7e and L-S4 chat-1269fb2858. Each lane keeps its running swarm (smwh3rjmh, smwh3qj8e, smwh3s439, smwh3q4bu). No successors were started, because all 18 lanes have running swarms and none reports laneIdle.

Research desk noV1 result: recorded as compiled, not as a line saving. Exit 0, 181 s, standard axioms, 30 #check signatures identical to R1, code lines 341->350 (+9). The only consumers of five_support_step_ban are FiveSupport:198-199.

This result went only to L-S3, as an archive note. The simplification desk has told that lane to stop swap work, and I did not reopen it.

One reconciliation item for the desks: the simplification desk's v3 is claimed at -15 lines net on R1 and is still compiling locally. The research desk's compiled noV1 is +9. These are different files. Only the +9 figure is Lean-checked; treat -15 as unverified until v3 compiles.

L-S3 reported that the work/... paths do not exist on its VM. I told it to use its supplied base. Its whole partition is byte-identical to R1, so line numbers carry over.

No Lean proposals this cycle: the queue is idle and there are no new reviewed inbox artifacts. CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2 stays retired per plan.
summary:
R1 accepted by Jarom; 27-module closure and root axioms passed locally.

Step-ban noV1 port compiles at +9 code lines. It is a structural change, not a shortening. The desk's v3 at -15 lines is pending compile.

The joint-pair replacement of five_support_no_sixty is withdrawn; it would add 33 lines.

Simplification lanes L-S1, L-S2 and L-S3 now audit disjoint R1-identical partitions for unused declarations, duplicates and shorter proofs. L-S4 maps the paper route after R1.

Solving lanes are unchanged and running.

No global chromatic improvement.
needs_parent: Reconcile step-ban figures: the simplification desk claims v3 at -15 lines on R1 (still compiling); the research desk's compiled noV1 port is +9 code lines (sha 0aaee265). Only +9 is Lean-checked. Record -15 only after v3 compiles.
The simplification desk's Lean reachability (unreachable-declaration) list is promised to L-S1, L-S2 and L-S3. Please forward it when ready.
